    How this estimate works

    Team weekly hours = people × repetitive hours per person. Task weekly hours = tasks × minutes × working days ÷ 60. Monthly hours use 52 ÷ 12 weeks; annual values use 52 weeks. Workload cost = monthly hours × hourly staff cost. Returned capacity = monthly hours × your estimated workload reduction. Its value uses the same hourly rate. Net monthly value subtracts recurring costs; payback divides setup cost by positive net monthly value.

    These are estimates. Actual results depend on the workflow and implementation. They are not a quote. Capacity value is not necessarily cash saved or fewer employees. Validate the assumptions against a real workflow and include review time, all operating costs, and implementation effort.

    A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

    Let’s clear
    things up.

    What can AutixAI automate?

    Lead capture, support routing, WhatsApp workflows, reporting, data entry and routine operations. We start with a repeatable process and check where automation would be useful.

    Do I need to replace my existing software?

    Usually no. We first assess the tools you already use and their APIs or supported integrations. Any gaps or required changes are explained before agreeing the scope.

    Can you integrate with WhatsApp?

    Yes, where supported by the WhatsApp Business Platform and your account setup. Message rules, templates, consent and handover requirements are checked for your workflow.

    Can you connect our CRM?

    We assess your CRM’s API, permissions and available integrations. Leads, contacts, activities and follow-ups can be connected where the tool supports them.

    Can you work with Google Sheets?

    Yes. Sheets can be a source or destination for structured records, reminders and reports. We define validation, access and duplicate handling before connecting it.

    Can AI make mistakes?

    Yes. We test with representative cases, use approved knowledge, flag uncertain outputs and add human review where a mistake would matter.

    More about control, timing and cost
    Will employees still be able to control the automation?

    Yes. Review points, exceptions and pause controls can be included. The goal is to remove routine workload while your people keep important decisions.

    How long does an automation project take?

    It depends on the scope, tool access, data readiness and testing. We agree a realistic timeline and milestones after understanding the process.

    Can we start with one workflow?

    Yes. One clear, repetitive process is a practical starting point. Review the result before deciding what to automate next.

    Can the system grow later?

    Yes. We can plan for additional workflows and tools. Expansion is scoped separately as your requirements become clearer.

    Do you provide support after launch?

    Support and monitoring can be included in the project scope. We agree what is covered, who handles exceptions and how changes are requested before launch.

    How much does automation cost?

    The price depends on the workflow, integrations, custom work and support. We provide a clear scope and quote before development, including expected recurring provider costs.
